title: 🛡️ Insurance Audit — BTS MS
foot: 🛡️ MS 1 · The Insurance Audit — B1–B2 · self-marking 🛡️
story: Théo works as a maintenance technician in a large production factory. Once a year, an insurance surveyor visits the plant for a safety audit. Nobody can lower the insurance premium if the factory fails the inspection, so Théo prepares everything with care.

This morning, the surveyor arrived at nine and put on a helmet and safety glasses. She checked every fire extinguisher, opened the electrical cabinets and tested the emergency exits. She also inspected the machine guards and found a small oil leak under the compressor.

Since January, the team has repaired every guard and has updated the maintenance logbook. They haven't fixed the oil leak yet, but the surveyor says it is only a minor hazard. Good compliance is the best way to keep the factory safe and the premium low. 🛡️

sections.name: TR Traduction
sections.heading: Traduis : choisis la bonne phrase anglaise
sections.instr: Le sens est le même — seul le temps change. Choisis la traduction correcte.

options: Since this morning, the technician checked all the fire extinguishers.
Since this morning, the technician has checked all the fire extinguishers.
items.answer: Since this morning, the technician has checked all the fire extinguishers.
